navigation.title: Navigation and Shell Chrome
navigation.purpose: Global instrument-workbench chrome surrounding every NusaShell view: title bar, window controls, update banner, two-mode sidebar, documentation link, and connection status.
navigation.howToOpen: Always visible when the NusaShell main window is open.

sections.heading: Update banner
paragraphs: A status banner at the top of the window that reports update availability, download progress, and a restart prompt.

sections.heading: Title bar
paragraphs: The top bar identifies NusaShell with its tile-and-wave brand mark and wordmark, followed by compact backend connection status, settings and always-on-top shortcuts, and native window controls. Graphite rails frame the shell while phosphor is reserved for live, selected, focused, and primary-action state. App search is intentionally scoped to Home.

sections.heading: Sidebar
paragraphs: Vertical navigation on the left, ordered Home, Agent, Skills, Learning, Plugins, AI Providers, Autostart, and Logs. It can show icons with labels or icons only, remembers that choice locally, and links to the project documentation on GitHub from its footer.

home.title: Home (Launcher)
home.purpose: The default view and app launcher. Shows windowed (UI) plugins as a searchable grid of app tiles. Headless MCP-only plugins do not appear here — manage them from the Plugins view.
home.howToOpen: Open NusaShell, or click the Home item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Greeting
paragraphs: Displays a compact local-workbench kicker, the product name, and the tagline 'Your AI tool shell — plugins with real UIs.'

sections.heading: Search and filters
paragraphs: The Home search filters installed plugin cards by name, id, or description in real time. It spans the launcher above a compact, horizontally scrollable category rail so both filters read as one deliberate sequence.

sections.heading: App grid
paragraphs: A grid of installed UI plugins (plugins whose manifest declares a `ui.entry`). Each tile uses an instrument-style launch plate and shows the plugin icon, name, and a textual state badge (idle, starting, running, stopping, crashed). Headless MCP-only plugins are filtered out of Home and managed from the Plugins view. Emoji and image artwork share one normalized plate; transparent margins in local PNG artwork are normalized at render time so mixed icon sources keep comparable visual weight.

sections.heading: Empty state
paragraphs: When no plugins are installed, the grid shows a message pointing to the example plugin folder.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.purpose: List of all installed plugins (UI and headless MCP-only) with their live MCP process state in a compact table. Headless plugins that do not appear on Home are managed here.
plugins.howToOpen: Click the Plugins item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Plugin table
paragraphs: Shows plugin icon, name, plugin id, version, and current state for every installed plugin, including headless MCP-only plugins that do not appear on Home. Click any row to open the plugin detail drawer.

plugin-detail.title: Plugin Detail Drawer
plugin-detail.purpose: A right-side drawer that shows details for the selected plugin and lets you start, stop, restart, or uninstall it.
plugin-detail.howToOpen: Click a plugin tile on the Home view or a row on the Plugins view, or choose Details from the context menu.

sections.heading: Header
paragraphs: Shows the plugin icon, name, and plugin id with version. The close button dismisses the drawer.

sections.heading: State
paragraphs: Visual state machine that highlights idle, starting, running, stopping, and crashed states.

sections.heading: Actions
paragraphs: Primary lifecycle actions for the selected plugin.

sections.heading: Tools
paragraphs: Lists the tools reported by the plugin's MCP server when running. If the plugin is idle, it prompts to start it so tools can be discovered. If the tool listing fails (e.g. plugin crashed or transport error), it shows a Tools unavailable message with the error reason instead of a silent Tools=0.

sections.heading: Manifest
paragraphs: Displays the plugin manifest (name, version, description, permissions, etc.).

agent.title: Agent
agent.purpose: The agent conversation workspace. Chat with the NusaShell agent, attach files, pick models, and manage conversation threads.
agent.howToOpen: Click the Agent item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Conversation list
paragraphs: A fixed workbench rail listing local conversation threads. Click a thread to open it; use the × button to delete. The rail remains visible beside a wider conversation surface at desktop widths.

sections.heading: Conversation thread
paragraphs: The full-height message runway separates compact user cards from editorial assistant responses. User attachments render as image previews or file cards. Provider reasoning is persisted and appears before the answer in a collapsed Thinking disclosure with sanitized Markdown; models that return no reasoning show no placeholder. Completed tool calls render as expandable terminal cards with the tool name in the header and full args/output in the body. Interactive ask_question calls render as Ask Question cards with selectable options and an optional free-text answer; after the user replies, the sealed card shows the chosen answer. Message footers expose timestamps, model/trace metadata, copy, and retry where applicable. Only this area scrolls.

sections.heading: Subagent activity
paragraphs: When the parent agent delegates work through the subagent tool, an in-chat Subagent run card appears in the message thread. While the subagent run is active, the card shows a compact mini activity stream (roughly ten monospace rows) that mirrors the full Subagent side pane: live reasoning, text snippets, tool calls with success/failure marks, and plan progress. The mini stream auto-scrolls to the bottom while the user is pinned to the tail; scrolling up pauses stickiness until the user returns to the bottom. Clicking the card head opens the full Subagent side pane, which preserves the complete live log with markdown rendering, expandable tool terminals, plan steps, and permission/ask cards. Clicks inside the mini stream do not toggle the drawer. When the run ends, the mini stream freezes in place until the parent turn seals the tool card; the side pane keeps the full frozen history for review.

sections.heading: Composer
paragraphs: A compact command dock at the bottom of the thread. Its message input starts at one row, grows with wrapped or explicit lines, and caps at ten rows before scrolling internally. Attachment, model, and workspace context stay grouped separately from context usage and turn actions; long labels truncate, and actions wrap below only at very narrow widths.

sections.heading: Task strip
paragraphs: A collapsible checklist above the composer that mirrors the agent-owned todo list. The agent writes it via the `todo` meta-tool; the user can delete individual items (which removes them from the runtime port so they do not reappear in the next prompt injection) and collapse the strip. It hides automatically when the list is empty.

sections.heading: Background jobs strip
paragraphs: A strip above the composer (below the task strip) that shows running and recently finished async tool jobs started via `async_run`. Each card shows the tool name, status badge, live tail output, and a Stop button that calls `agent.tool_job_kill`. The strip rehydrates from `agent.tool_job_list` on conversation open and hides when no jobs are active.

sections.heading: Delete conversation dialog
paragraphs: Confirmation dialog shown before permanently removing a conversation thread.

sections.heading: Agent Canvas
paragraphs: A shell-owned canvas drawer over the agent workbench. Completed assistant messages auto-render html, svg, and mermaid fences inline (mermaid is lazy-loaded, strict mode; html uses a sandboxed iframe via renderArtifact, sandbox=allow-scripts, no allow-same-origin, CSP with an empty external allowlist in v1); the raw fence is hidden after a successful render. Show source hides the inline preview and reveals a scrollable source block capped at about 10 rows; Hide source restores the preview. Sidebar opens the overlay drawer. html fences also show a compact artifact card with a type badge, title, size hint, Sidebar, and Show source. The drawer slides in from the right with a dimmed overlay (plugin-drawer style); it shows one active artifact at a time with a type badge, Refresh, Download source, and Close (overlay click or Escape also closes). Artifacts persist per conversation and restore on reopen; a Settings toggle disables the canvas entirely.

skills.title: Skills
skills.purpose: Managed file workspace for installing, inspecting, editing, and deleting agent skill packages.
skills.howToOpen: Click the Skills item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Skill library
paragraphs: Lists installed skills with their descriptions and file counts. Search filters the local library, while Install package opens a native picker for .skill and .zip archives.

sections.heading: Package files
paragraphs: Shows the selected skill package as a compact file tree. Text and binary entries are visually distinguished, and selecting a file opens it in the adjacent viewer.

sections.heading: File editor
paragraphs: UTF-8 text files can be edited and saved in place. Binary or large files expose metadata without rendering their contents. Delete skill removes the entire managed package after confirmation.

sections.heading: Curator
paragraphs: Shows the skill curator's last-run timestamp and running state. Run executes the curator to transition stale skills to archived; Dry-run previews changes without applying them.

sections.heading: Pending writes
paragraphs: Lists skill writes authored by the agent that await user approval. Each row shows the action, skill id, and file path, with Approve and Reject buttons.

sections.heading: Archived skills
paragraphs: Lists skills the curator has archived. Each row shows the skill name and description with a Restore button.

learning.title: Learning
learning.purpose: Reviews saved learning data in two focused views: a table for timeline and node details, and a full-width Connections graph.
learning.howToOpen: Click the Learning item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: View tabs
paragraphs: Switches between the Table view for browsing and editing nodes and the Connections view for exploring relationships across the full available width.

sections.heading: Stats
paragraphs: Summary cards showing the total number of learned skills, memory entries, agent-created nodes, and nodes used in turns.

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The Table view contains a chronological list of learning nodes grouped by day. Each row shows a colored dot indicating kind (skill or memory) and state (active, stale, archived), the node label, category, use count, and a pin indicator. Click a row to inspect it in the detail pane.

sections.heading: Constellation
paragraphs: The Connections view gives the graph the full panel width. It uses a compact force layout for related nodes and packs isolated nodes nearby, with edges between related skills. Node size reflects connection degree and labels become selective on larger graphs as the user zooms. Node color reflects kind and state. Click a dot to select the node and highlight its neighborhood. A time scrubber below fades nodes that fall after the selected percentage of the timeline.

sections.heading: Detail
paragraphs: Shows the selected node's label and content. Memory nodes can be edited and saved; skill nodes are read-only and can be archived. Delete archives skills or removes memory entries after confirmation.

ai-providers.title: AI Providers
ai-providers.purpose: Registry of built-in and custom AI provider connections. Enable, disable, and configure providers here.
ai-providers.howToOpen: Click the AI Providers item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Provider registry
paragraphs: Cards for OpenRouter, OmniRoute, 9Router, OpenAI, Claude API, and any custom providers. Each card shows status, model count, and primary action.

sections.heading: Add custom provider
paragraphs: Button to create a new custom OpenAI-compatible provider.

sections.heading: ACP agents
paragraphs: Registry of ACP (Agent Client Protocol) external agents. Enable and configure providers such as Cursor, Devin, Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini. The Subagent routing card chooses a connected default and fallback order; each provider card shows a Connect button that runs a one-shot acp.probe (spawn → initialize → authenticate → session/new → close) and persists authStatus as connected or needs-auth. Connected providers are available as subagent targets via the subagent tool from within an agent conversation.

sections.heading: ACP provider configure modal
paragraphs: Modal for editing an ACP provider's command, args, enabled state, auth method, and whether it is the default subagent ACP agent. The auth method select lists the provider's advertised authMethodIds (e.g. cursor_login, api-key); choosing Default/file auth omits authMethodId so the client can fall back to file tokens (e.g. ~/.codex).

provider-details.title: Provider Details
provider-details.purpose: Deep view for one provider: connection info, imported models, import catalog, add model, edit, and delete.
provider-details.howToOpen: Click Details or Configure on an AI Providers card.

sections.heading: Provider summary
paragraphs: Back link, provider name, API type, base URL, masked API key state, default model, and enabled status.

sections.heading: Provider actions
paragraphs: Edit the connection, import the provider's model catalog, or delete the provider.

sections.heading: Available models
paragraphs: Searchable list of imported models. Each row shows model id, label, context window, input modes, and capability badges.

autostart.title: Autostart
autostart.purpose: Choose which MCP server plugins start automatically when NusaShell launches.
autostart.howToOpen: Click the Autostart item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Autostart list
paragraphs: One row per installed plugin with a toggle. The header shows how many plugins are enabled.

logs.title: Logs
logs.purpose: Live tail of renderer, Electron, IPC, backend, and MCP process log messages, with retained counts per producer.
logs.howToOpen: Click the Logs item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Log filters
paragraphs: Chips filter the tail by source and show how many retained entries each producer has. Electron receives main-process console output, IPC receives window and tool-call activity, and Backend receives server logger output; an empty source explains what action produces entries.

sections.heading: Log tail
paragraphs: The log card fills the remaining shell viewport and scrolls internally, so tall windows do not leave a detached empty area below it. The tail auto-sticks to the bottom and shows retained counts.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.purpose: Scheduled automation that fires headless agent turns or plugin tool calls on a once/interval/cron schedule while NusaShell is open.
jobs.howToOpen: Click the Jobs item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Job list
paragraphs: Lists all scheduled jobs. Each row leads with a status dot and shows the job name, schedule, mode, and repeat progress, plus a schedule strip with a humanized next run time and a textual last status (Never / OK / Error). Each row offers Run, Pause/Resume, Output, and Remove actions. An inline error panel appears when the list fails to load, and an empty state offers a New job action.

sections.heading: Job row actions
paragraphs: Each job row has Run (fire immediately), Stop (cancel an in-flight run, visible only while running), Pause/Resume (toggle enabled), Edit (opens the create/edit modal prefilled), Output (recent run summaries), and Remove (opens a delete confirmation dialog). While a job is running, the row highlights with a pulsing dot and the Run/Pause buttons are disabled.

sections.heading: Job delete confirmation
paragraphs: An in-app dialog confirms job removal before deleting it via job.remove. It opens from a row's Remove action and closes on Cancel, overlay click, or Escape.

job-modal.title: New job modal
job-modal.purpose: Form to create a new scheduled job with name, schedule expression, mode (agent prompt or plugin tool call), and optional repeat limit.
job-modal.howToOpen: Click the + New job button in the Jobs view.

sections.heading: Job form
paragraphs: Name, trigger picker (schedule vs event), schedule (every 30m / 2h / 1d / 5-field cron / ISO timestamp) or event pattern + plugin scope + throttle/max-fires, mode selector, agent prompt + model picker or plugin tool schema form, and optional repeat count. Schedule is validated on blur with a live description or error. Event pattern hints show available event types from the selected plugin's manifest automation.emits. The mode-dependent fields toggle via hidden + aria-hidden. Agent mode shows a required Prompt textarea plus Provider/Model/Effort selects (Default = shell active settings). Tool mode shows Plugin and Tool dropdowns populated from the live catalog, then a schema-driven arg form (primitives/enums as native inputs, object/array as JSON textareas); a JSON fallback textarea appears when no schema is available. An optional 'Emit on complete' section allows configuring an onComplete emit event type and payload for soft chains. The Edit button on a row opens this modal prefilled and saves via job.update. The dialog supports Escape and overlay click to close, and returns focus to the trigger on close.

pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.purpose: Multi-step DAG pipelines that chain multiple agent turns or tool calls with conditional branching and context passing.
pipelines.howToOpen: Click the Pipelines item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Pipeline list
paragraphs: Lists all pipelines. Each card shows the pipeline name, status, trigger type (event or schedule), step count, and enabled/disabled state. Each card offers Edit, Run now, Enable/Disable, and Delete actions. An inline error panel appears when the list fails to load, and an empty state offers a New pipeline action.

pipeline-modal.title: Pipeline editor modal
pipeline-modal.purpose: Form to create or edit a multi-step pipeline with a trigger, step list, and per-step configuration.
pipeline-modal.howToOpen: Click the + New pipeline button in the Pipelines view, or Edit on a pipeline card.

sections.heading: Pipeline form
paragraphs: The modal collects a pipeline name, optional description, trigger type (event or schedule with pattern/schedule fields), and a list of steps. Each step has an id, name, action type (agent prompt or plugin tool call), optional dependsOn (multi-select of other step IDs), and optional outputKey. Steps can be added or removed dynamically.

job-output-modal.title: Job output modal
job-output-modal.purpose: Shows recent run output entries (run time, status, summary) for a selected job.
job-output-modal.howToOpen: Click the Output button on a job row.

sections.heading: Output entries
paragraphs: Lists up to 20 recent output entries newest-first, each showing the run timestamp, status (ok/error/cancelled), and a truncated summary. Each entry has a Show full output button that loads the full markdown body from disk via job.output with includeBody. The dialog supports Escape and overlay click to close.

settings.title: Settings
settings.purpose: System configuration, connection status, startup/background behavior, agent runtime preferences, and app info.
settings.howToOpen: Click the settings gear icon in the title bar, or use the Settings navigation if added.

sections.heading: System
paragraphs: Shows the running NusaShell version, backend connection state, WebSocket URL, and a manual ping button.

sections.heading: Connection
paragraphs: Toggles for WebSocket auto-reconnect and auto-resubscribe.

sections.heading: Startup & background
paragraphs: Controls OS login autostart, tray-first launch, and whether closing the launcher hides to the tray so learning and scheduled work keep running. Descriptions wrap in the text column beside each fixed-width toggle. Quit from the tray menu for a full stop.

sections.heading: Agent runtime
paragraphs: Configures how the agent picks and retries models: provider strategy, attempt budget, vision mode, user prompt, and streaming.

sections.heading: Agent limits
paragraphs: Controls how many tool calls and rounds the agent can make per turn. Prevents runaway loops.

sections.heading: Context compaction
paragraphs: Controls how the agent compacts conversation history when the input token budget is exceeded.

sections.heading: About
paragraphs: Product name and build label.

add-plugin-modal.title: Add Plugin Modal
add-plugin-modal.purpose: Install a plugin from a remote URL or a locally selected folder/archive.
add-plugin-modal.howToOpen: Click the Add Plugin button in the sidebar or the Home empty-state prompt.

sections.heading: Install options
paragraphs: Install from a URL, choose a local plugin folder with the native directory picker, or choose a zip/tar.gz archive with the native file picker. The selected path is read-only.

sections.heading: Install status
paragraphs: Displays progress, success, or error text after an install attempt. The modal closes automatically on success.

provider-editor.title: Provider Editor
provider-editor.purpose: Form to configure or edit an AI provider connection and its runtime defaults.
provider-editor.howToOpen: Click Configure on a provider card, or Edit on the Provider Details view.

sections.heading: Identity
paragraphs: For custom providers: name and id/prefix. Built-in providers hide those custom identity fields and use their preset id. API mode remains visible for every provider so the request dialect can match the endpoint.

sections.heading: Connection
paragraphs: Base URL, API key, and default model for the provider.

sections.heading: Runtime
paragraphs: Timeout in seconds, retry attempts, routing weight, and enabled toggle.

provider-delete-dialog.title: Delete Provider Dialog
provider-delete-dialog.purpose: Confirmation before removing a provider and its saved credentials.
provider-delete-dialog.howToOpen: Click Delete on an AI Providers card or on the Provider Details view.

sections.heading: Confirmation
paragraphs: Warns that the saved credential, imported models, and connection settings will be removed from this device.

context-menu.title: Context Menu
context-menu.purpose: Floating menu with context-specific actions. Plugin tiles/rows show plugin actions; inputs show edit actions.
context-menu.howToOpen: Right-click a plugin tile/row, or right-click an input/textarea for edit actions.

sections.heading: Edit actions
paragraphs: Available when right-clicking inside an input or textarea.

sections.heading: Plugin actions
paragraphs: Available when right-clicking a plugin tile or row.

acp-provider-details.title: ACP Provider Details
acp-provider-details.purpose: Deep view for one ACP agent: connection info, imported models, default model/mode selection, import catalog, edit, and live config-option snapshot.
acp-provider-details.howToOpen: Click Details on a connected ACP Agents card.

sections.heading: ACP agent summary
paragraphs: Back link, agent display name, description, command, auth status, default model, default mode, and enabled status.

sections.heading: ACP agent actions
paragraphs: Edit the agent configuration or import its model catalog by probing a fresh session.

sections.heading: Models
paragraphs: Searchable list of imported models discovered from the last probe. Each row shows model id and label.

sections.heading: Defaults
paragraphs: Default model and default mode (bypass / yolo) selects. Applied to every subagent run and ACP thread from this agent via preferredConfig.

sections.heading: Config options snapshot
paragraphs: Read-only snapshot of live session config options from the last probe, excluding model and mode which have their own controls above.

update-banner.label: Update banner
update-banner.action: Displays update availability and download progress. Hidden when no update is pending.

update-banner-text.label: Update banner text
update-banner-text.action: Shows the current update message, e.g. 'Update available: vX.Y.Z' or download percentage.

update-banner-btn.label: Restart to update
update-banner-btn.action: Quits and installs the downloaded update after confirmation. Only shown when an update is ready.

update-banner-close.label: Close update banner
update-banner-close.action: Dismisses the update banner until the next update event.

search-input.label: Installed app search
search-input.action: Filters only the Home app grid by plugin name, plugin id, or description as the user types.
search-input.shortcut: Escape clears the current query when the input is focused.

search-clear.label: Clear search
search-clear.action: Clears the global app search field and refocuses it.

nav-settings-btn.label: Settings
nav-settings-btn.action: Switches to the Settings view from anywhere in the app.

window-always-on-top.label: Keep window on top
window-always-on-top.action: Toggles whether the NusaShell launcher stays above other desktop windows for the current app session.

window-maximize.label: Maximize / restore window
window-maximize.action: Toggles the NusaShell window between normal and maximized state.

window-close.label: Close window
window-close.action: Closes the NusaShell window. The backend may continue running in the tray.

nav-home.label: Home navigation
nav-home.action: Switches the main content to the Home (launcher) view.

nav-plugins.label: Plugins navigation
nav-plugins.action: Switches the main content to the Plugins list view.

nav-agent.label: Agent navigation
nav-agent.action: Switches the main content to the Agent conversation view.

nav-skills.label: Skills navigation
nav-skills.action: Switches the main content to the managed Skills workspace.

skills-install-btn.label: Install package
skills-install-btn.action: Opens a native file picker and installs a .skill or .zip package into NusaShell's managed skills directory.

skills-search.label: Search skills
skills-search.action: Filters installed skills by name and description.

skills-list.label: Installed skills
skills-list.action: Lists installed skills and selects the package shown in the file tree.

skills-empty.label: Skills empty state
skills-empty.action: Explains how to install the first skill, or reports when the desktop bridge is unavailable.

skills-file-tree.label: Skill file tree
skills-file-tree.action: Lists directories and files within the selected managed skill package.

skills-file-count.label: Skill file count
skills-file-count.action: Shows the number of files in the selected skill package.

skill-file-title.label: Selected file
skill-file-title.action: Shows the relative path of the file open in the viewer.

skill-file-meta.label: File metadata
skill-file-meta.action: Shows file size and whether the selected file is editable UTF-8 text.

skill-editor.label: Skill text editor
skill-editor.action: Edits the selected UTF-8 text file inside the managed skill.

skill-binary-view.label: Binary file viewer
skill-binary-view.action: Shows safe metadata instead of rendering binary or oversized file contents.

skill-save-btn.label: Save file
skill-save-btn.action: Writes changes to the selected text file inside the managed skill.

skill-delete-btn.label: Delete skill
skill-delete-btn.action: Deletes the selected managed skill package after confirmation.

skill-pin-btn.label: Pin / Unpin skill
skill-pin-btn.action: Toggles the pinned state of the selected skill. Pinned skills are excluded from curator archival.

skills-curator-status.label: Curator status
skills-curator-status.action: Shows the curator's last-run timestamp and whether it is currently running.

skills-curator-run.label: Run curator
skills-curator-run.action: Executes the skill curator to transition stale skills to archived based on usage and provenance.

skills-curator-dry-run.label: Dry-run curator
skills-curator-dry-run.action: Previews curator changes without applying them.

skills-pending-count.label: Pending count
skills-pending-count.action: Shows the number of pending skill writes awaiting approval.

skills-pending-refresh.label: Refresh pending
skills-pending-refresh.action: Reloads the list of pending skill writes from the backend.

skills-pending-list.label: Pending writes list
skills-pending-list.action: Lists agent-authored skill writes awaiting user approval, with Approve and Reject buttons per item.

skills-archived-count.label: Archived count
skills-archived-count.action: Shows the number of archived skills.

skills-archived-refresh.label: Refresh archived
skills-archived-refresh.action: Reloads the list of archived skills from the backend.

skills-archived-list.label: Archived skills list
skills-archived-list.action: Lists skills the curator has archived, with a Restore button per item.

nav-learning.label: Learning navigation
nav-learning.action: Switches the main content to the Learning journey view.

learning-stat-skills.label: Learned skills count
learning-stat-skills.action: Shows the total number of learned skill nodes in the graph.

learning-stat-memory.label: Memory entries count
learning-stat-memory.action: Shows the total number of memory entry nodes in the graph.

learning-stat-agent.label: Agent-created count
learning-stat-agent.action: Shows the number of nodes created by the agent (as opposed to user-created).

learning-stat-used.label: Used in turns count
learning-stat-used.action: Shows the number of nodes that have been used in at least one agent turn.

learning-tab-table.label: Table view
learning-tab-table.action: Shows the learning timeline and selected node detail.

learning-tab-connections.label: Connections view
learning-tab-connections.action: Shows the full-width learning connections graph.

learning-timeline-list.label: Learning timeline
learning-timeline-list.action: Chronological list of learning nodes grouped by day. Click a row to inspect it in the detail pane.

learning-timeline-count.label: Timeline node count
learning-timeline-count.action: Shows the total number of nodes in the timeline.

learning-empty.label: Learning empty state
learning-empty.action: Shown when the agent has not created any skills or memory entries yet.

learning-constellation-canvas.label: Constellation graph
learning-constellation-canvas.action: Visualizes learning nodes with Sigma.js and Graphology using a force-directed layout, curved edges, semantic zoom, and neighborhood selection.

learning-constellation-meta.label: Constellation metadata
learning-constellation-meta.action: Shows the number of edges in the constellation graph.

learning-zoom-reset.label: Reset connection zoom
learning-zoom-reset.action: Returns the connection graph to 100% scale.

learning-zoom-value.label: Connection zoom value
learning-zoom-value.action: Shows the current connection graph scale.

learning-scrubber.label: Time scrubber
learning-scrubber.action: Fades nodes that fall after the selected percentage of the timeline, revealing how the journey grew over time.

learning-detail-meta.label: Node detail metadata
learning-detail-meta.action: Shows the label of the currently selected node.

learning-detail-empty.label: Detail empty state
learning-detail-empty.action: Prompt to select a node from the timeline or constellation.

learning-detail-editor.label: Node content editor
learning-detail-editor.action: Shows the content of the selected node. Memory nodes can be edited; skill nodes are read-only.

learning-save-btn.label: Save node
learning-save-btn.action: Saves edits to the selected memory node's content.

learning-delete-btn.label: Delete / Archive node
learning-delete-btn.action: Archives the selected skill node or removes the selected memory entry after confirmation.

learning-refresh-btn.label: Refresh graph
learning-refresh-btn.action: Reloads the entire learning graph from the backend.

nav-ai-providers.label: AI Providers navigation
nav-ai-providers.action: Switches the main content to the AI Providers registry view.

nav-autostart.label: Autostart navigation
nav-autostart.action: Switches the main content to the Autostart view.

nav-logs.label: Logs navigation
nav-logs.action: Switches the main content to the Logs tail view.

open-docs.label: Docs on GitHub
open-docs.action: Opens the NusaShell docs directory on GitHub in the system browser.

sidebar-mode-toggle.label: Sidebar display mode
sidebar-mode-toggle.action: Switches between icon-only and icon-with-text sidebar modes and remembers the choice on this device.

conn-status.label: Connection status text
conn-status.action: Displays 'Connecting...' or 'Connected' depending on the WebSocket state.

conn-fill.label: Connection status indicator
conn-fill.action: Changes from neutral to green when the backend WebSocket is connected.

home-filter-tabs.label: Filter tabs
home-filter-tabs.action: Tabs above the app grid that scope the list of plugins. Defaults to All.

app-grid.label: Installed plugin grid
app-grid.action: Container for plugin tiles. Renders an empty message when no plugins match or are installed.

app-grid-cell.label: Plugin tile
app-grid-cell.action: Click to open the plugin window. Right-click to open the plugin context menu. Shows icon, name, and state badge.

plugins-add-mcp.label: Add MCP
plugins-add-mcp.action: Opens the Custom MCP tab for creating a native headless MCP wrapper.

plugins-install-plugin.label: Install plugin
plugins-install-plugin.action: Opens the NusaShell Plugin tab for installing a packaged plugin.

btn-edit-mcp.label: Edit MCP
btn-edit-mcp.action: Opens the Custom MCP editor for the selected native MCP; hidden for package plugins.

plugin-table.label: Installed plugin table
plugin-table.action: Container for plugin rows. Renders an empty message when no plugins are installed.

plugin-row.label: Plugin row
plugin-row.action: Click to open the plugin detail drawer. Shows icon, name, plugin id, version, and state.

drawer-overlay.label: Drawer overlay
drawer-overlay.action: Clicking the dark backdrop closes the plugin detail drawer.

plugin-drawer.label: Plugin detail drawer
plugin-drawer.action: Right-side panel that opens when a plugin tile or row is selected.

drawer-icon.label: Plugin icon
drawer-icon.action: Shows the plugin icon in the detail drawer.

drawer-subtitle.label: Plugin id and version
drawer-subtitle.action: Displays the selected plugin id and version.

state-machine.label: State machine
state-machine.action: Highlights the plugin's lifecycle state: idle, starting, running, stopping, or crashed.

btn-start.label: Start
btn-start.action: Starts the selected plugin's MCP process.

btn-stop.label: Stop
btn-stop.action: Stops the selected plugin's MCP process.

btn-restart.label: Restart
btn-restart.action: Restarts the selected plugin's MCP process.

btn-uninstall.label: Uninstall
btn-uninstall.action: Removes the selected plugin after a confirmation prompt.

tool-count.label: Tool count
tool-count.action: Shows the number of tools discovered from the plugin's MCP server.

tools-list.label: Tools list
tools-list.action: Lists tool names reported by the running plugin. Empty when the plugin is idle.

manifest-info.label: Plugin manifest
manifest-info.action: Displays the plugin manifest including name, version, description, and permissions.

agent-conversation-count.label: Conversation count
agent-conversation-count.action: Displays the number of conversation threads.

agent-new-conversation.label: New conversation
agent-new-conversation.action: Creates a new empty conversation thread and focuses the composer.

agent-conversation-search.label: Search conversations
agent-conversation-search.action: Filters the conversation list by thread title as you type.

agent-conversation-list.label: Conversation list
agent-conversation-list.action: Container for conversation rows. Shows the active thread highlighted.

agent-conversation-item.label: Conversation row
agent-conversation-item.action: Click the row to open the conversation; click the × button to delete it.

agent-thread.label: Conversation thread
agent-thread.action: Main scrollable message area for the current conversation. Auto-scrolls as new content arrives.

acp-routing-settings.label: Fallback settings
acp-routing-settings.action: Opens the fallback order dialog for choosing the default ACP provider and fallback providers.

acp-routing-dialog.label: Fallback order dialog
acp-routing-dialog.action: Groups the default ACP provider and fallback controls for subagent delegation.

acp-routing-default.label: Default ACP agent
acp-routing-default.action: Chooses the connected ACP provider tried first by subagents, or manifest order when empty.

acp-routing-fallbacks.label: Fallback order
acp-routing-fallbacks.action: Chooses connected ACP providers that subagents try after the default.

acp-routing-status.label: Effective ACP order
acp-routing-status.action: Shows the currently resolved subagent try order.

acp-provider-default-badge.label: Default badge
acp-provider-default-badge.action: Marks the provider currently selected as the subagent default.

acp-provider-set-default.label: Set as default ACP
acp-provider-set-default.action: Sets this provider as the default ACP agent for subagent delegation when saved.

acp-status-bar.label: ACP status bar (legacy)
acp-status-bar.action: Shows the ACP provider name and running/idle chip for legacy peer-chat ACP conversations. Only visible on conversations with kind='acp'.
acp-status-bar.notes: Legacy. New ACP interactions use the subagent side pane, not peer-chat threads.

acp-status-provider.label: ACP status provider
acp-status-provider.action: Shows the provider id for the current ACP peer-chat conversation.

acp-status-chip.label: ACP status chip
acp-status-chip.action: Shows running/idle state for the current ACP peer-chat conversation.

agent-empty.label: Empty thread state
agent-empty.action: Shown when no conversation is selected or when a new conversation has no messages yet. Prompts to choose a model.

agent-message.label: Message row
agent-message.action: Displays a right-aligned user card or a full-width editorial assistant response with a compact metadata and action footer.

agent-bubble.label: Message bubble
agent-bubble.action: Displays plain text inside a compact user card; completed assistant messages render sanitized GitHub-Flavored Markdown directly on the conversation runway.

agent-message-attachments.label: Sent attachment preview
agent-message-attachments.action: Shows persisted image attachments as bounded thumbnails and PDF or text attachments as compact file cards above the user message.

agent-tool-terminal.label: Tool terminal
agent-tool-terminal.action: Timeline-style expandable tool call. Header keeps the ›_ rail badge plus tool name and status. Expand to inspect nested tool and Output panels with args and truncated result text.

agent-ask-card.label: Ask Question card
agent-ask-card.action: Rendered when the agent calls ask_question. Shows the question, selectable option rows, optional free-text answer, and Send answer. After the user replies or on reload, the sealed card shows the chosen answer.

agent-ask-option.label: Ask option
agent-ask-option.action: Selects one option (or toggles multi-select options) on an Ask Question card before sending the answer.

agent-ask-send.label: Send ask answer
agent-ask-send.action: Submits the selected option(s) or typed free-text answer for the pending ask_question tool call.

agent-reasoning.label: Thinking
agent-reasoning.action: Appears when the provider returns reasoning or a thinking summary. Expand it to inspect sanitized Markdown; it is collapsed by default and remains available after reopening the conversation.

agent-message-action.label: Copy message
agent-message-action.action: Copies the message text through the Electron clipboard bridge and briefly confirms success.

agent-retry-btn.label: Retry turn
agent-retry-btn.action: Appears on a failed assistant turn. Click to re-run the same turn.

agent-form.label: Composer form
agent-form.action: Wraps the message textarea, attachments, and send controls. Submit triggers the agent turn.

agent-todo-strip.label: Task strip
agent-todo-strip.action: Collapsible checklist above the composer mirroring the agent-owned todo list. Hides when the list is empty.

agent-todo-strip-toggle.label: Collapse tasks
agent-todo-strip-toggle.action: Collapses or expands the task list.

agent-todo-strip-list.label: Task list
agent-todo-strip-list.action: Renders each task with a status glyph and a delete button. Clicking the delete button removes the item via agent.todos_delete.

agent-tool-job-strip.label: Background jobs strip
agent-tool-job-strip.action: Shows running and recently finished async tool jobs. Hides when no jobs are active.

agent-tool-job-list.label: Job cards
agent-tool-job-list.action: Renders each job as a card with tool name, status badge, live tail, and a Stop button. Clicking Stop calls agent.tool_job_kill.

agent-input.label: Message input
agent-input.action: Primary text area for typing a prompt. Starts at one row, grows automatically with content, and scrolls internally after reaching ten rows.
agent-input.shortcut: Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter submits the turn.

agent-attachments.label: Attachment chips
agent-attachments.action: Shows files attached to the current turn. Each chip can be removed.

agent-file-input.label: File attachment input
agent-file-input.action: Hidden file picker triggered by the attach button. It inspects file bytes, accepting supported images and PDFs plus valid UTF-8 text such as source code, markup, and configuration; filenames and claimed MIME types are not trusted.

agent-attach-btn.label: Attach files
agent-attach-btn.action: Opens the file picker to attach images, PDFs, or UTF-8 text files to the current turn. Up to 4 files, each under 4 MiB. Text attachments are included as text context for every chat model. Unless image input is disabled in Agent runtime settings, images are sent optimistically; a provider 4xx response retries the same turn once without image parts.

agent-model-trigger.label: Model and effort trigger
agent-model-trigger.action: Opens the model/effort picker dropdown. Label shows the selected model and effort, e.g. 'Model · auto'.

agent-model-trigger-label.label: Model trigger label
agent-model-trigger-label.action: Text inside the model trigger showing the selected model id and effort value.

agent-model-menu.label: Model picker dropdown
agent-model-menu.action: Searchable list of imported models. Capability badges distinguish vision, no vision, and vision unknown using explicit provider metadata only; they do not block image attachments. Choose a model and, if supported, a reasoning effort level.

agent-model-search.label: Search models
agent-model-search.action: Filters the model picker list by model id, label, provider, or capability.

agent-model-list.label: Model list
agent-model-list.action: Container for model rows in the picker.

agent-provider-status.label: Context usage status
agent-provider-status.action: Shows approximate used / total context window fill for the selected model (from agent.context estimates and local chars/4 estimates — not cumulative billed input tokens), or 'Choose a model' when none is selected.

agent-stop-btn.label: Stop turn
agent-stop-btn.action: Cancels the currently running agent turn. Visible only while a turn is in progress.

agent-send-btn.label: Send turn
agent-send-btn.action: Submits the composer form and starts the agent turn. Shortcut is shown as a tooltip (Ctrl+Enter / ⌘↩).
agent-send-btn.shortcut: Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter submits the turn.

agent-delete-overlay.label: Delete overlay
agent-delete-overlay.action: Clicking outside the dialog closes it without deleting.

agent-delete-dialog.label: Delete conversation confirmation
agent-delete-dialog.action: Confirms permanent removal of the selected conversation thread.

agent-delete-copy.label: Dialog description
agent-delete-copy.action: Explains that the local conversation will be permanently removed.

agent-delete-confirm.label: Delete
agent-delete-confirm.action: Permanently deletes the selected conversation thread.

provider-preset-card.label: Provider preset card
provider-preset-card.action: Built-in provider card. Shows provider name, kind, status, enable toggle, and Configure/Details action.

provider-card-action.label: Provider card action
provider-card-action.action: Label changes between Configure (not set up) and Details (configured). Opens the provider editor or provider details.

provider-toggle.label: Enable provider
provider-toggle.action: Enables or disables the provider for agent turns. Disabled until the provider is configured.

provider-status.label: Provider status
provider-status.action: Shows 'Not configured', 'Needs API key', or 'Configured · N models'.

add-custom-provider.label: Add custom provider
add-custom-provider.action: Opens the provider editor for a new custom OpenAI-compatible provider.

provider-details-back.label: Back to AI Providers
provider-details-back.action: Returns to the AI Providers registry list.

provider-detail-subtitle.label: Provider id and API type
provider-detail-subtitle.action: Displays the provider id and API type (chat/responses/messages).

provider-detail-base-url.label: Base URL
provider-detail-base-url.action: Displays the configured API base URL or 'Local'.

provider-detail-key.label: API key state
provider-detail-key.action: Shows whether an API key is saved, optional, or missing.

provider-detail-default-model.label: Default model
provider-detail-default-model.action: Displays the provider's default model or 'Not set — choose per turn'.

provider-detail-status.label: Enabled status
provider-detail-status.action: Shows whether the provider is Enabled or Disabled.

provider-detail-edit.label: Edit
provider-detail-edit.action: Opens the provider editor for this provider.

provider-import-models.label: Import models
provider-import-models.action: Fetches the provider's model catalog and imports it. Errors appear in the provider import error box.

provider-detail-delete.label: Delete
provider-detail-delete.action: Opens the delete provider confirmation dialog.

provider-import-error.label: Import error message
provider-import-error.action: Displays an error when model import fails.

provider-model-count.label: Model count
provider-model-count.action: Shows the number of imported models for this provider.

provider-model-search.label: Search imported models
provider-model-search.action: Filters the imported model list by id, label, or description.

provider-add-model.label: Add model
provider-add-model.action: Prompts for a model id and optional display label, then adds it manually to the provider.

provider-model-item.label: Model row
provider-model-item.action: Displays model id, label, context window, input modes, and capability badges.

autostart-count.label: Enabled count
autostart-count.action: Shows how many plugins are set to autostart.

autostart-list.label: Autostart list
autostart-list.action: Container for plugin rows, each with a toggle for starting on launch.

autostart-toggle.label: Autostart toggle
autostart-toggle.action: Enables or disables autostart for the adjacent plugin.

log-count.label: Log count
log-count.action: Shows the total retained entries against the 1,000-entry limit. Each source chip shows its own retained count.

log-filter-all.label: All logs
log-filter-all.action: Shows log entries from all sources.

log-filter-main.label: Electron logs
log-filter-main.action: Shows only Electron main process log entries.

log-filter-mcp.label: MCP logs
log-filter-mcp.action: Shows only MCP process log entries.

log-tail.label: Log tail
log-tail.action: Scrollable live tail of log messages. Auto-sticks to the bottom.

settings-build.label: Build type
settings-build.action: Displays dev for an unpackaged --dev run and production for packaged or non-dev runs.

settings-about-version.label: Application version
settings-about-version.action: Displays the running NusaShell version in the About card.

settings-conn-dot.label: Backend status dot
settings-conn-dot.action: Visual dot showing whether the backend WebSocket is connected.

settings-ws-url.label: WebSocket URL
settings-ws-url.action: Displays the WebSocket URL the app is connected to.

ping-btn.label: Ping
ping-btn.action: Sends a ping to the backend and shows 'pong: true' or an error.

ping-result.label: Ping result
ping-result.action: Displays the ping response or error after clicking Ping.

connection-auto-reconnect.label: Auto-reconnect
connection-auto-reconnect.action: When enabled, the renderer reconnects to the backend automatically if the WebSocket drops.

connection-auto-resubscribe.label: Auto-resubscribe
connection-auto-resubscribe.action: When enabled, the renderer re-subscribes to backend events after reconnecting.

app-behavior-card.label: Startup & background card
app-behavior-card.action: Holds login autostart, start-in-tray, and keep-in-background toggles for the desktop shell.

settings-launch-at-login.label: Launch at login
settings-launch-at-login.action: When enabled on a packaged build, writes OS login autostart so NusaShell starts after login. Disabled in unpackaged/dev builds.

settings-start-hidden.label: Start in tray
settings-start-hidden.action: When launch-at-login starts the app, stay in the system tray until Open NusaShell is chosen.

settings-keep-in-background.label: Keep running when window is closed
settings-keep-in-background.action: Closing the launcher hides to the tray instead of quitting so learning and jobs keep running. Quit from the tray menu to stop fully.

ai-runtime-form.label: Agent runtime form
ai-runtime-form.action: Contains the provider strategy, attempt budget, vision, and stream settings. Submit saves the runtime.

settings-ai-strategy.label: Provider strategy
settings-ai-strategy.action: Controls model selection: Failover, Round robin, or Selected provider only.

settings-ai-budget.label: Total attempt budget
settings-ai-budget.action: Maximum number of agent tool-call attempts per turn (1–32).

settings-ai-vision.label: Vision
settings-ai-vision.action: Controls image delivery. Automatic sends image parts first and retries once without them after a provider 4xx response; Disable omits image pixels.

settings-ai-stream.label: Stream responses
settings-ai-stream.action: Enables streaming assistant responses when the provider supports it.

settings-ai-user-prompt.label: User prompt
settings-ai-user-prompt.action: Additional instructions appended after the system prompt. Use for personality, tone, or task-specific guidance.

ai-limits-form.label: Agent limits form
ai-limits-form.action: Contains max tool rounds and max repeated tool calls. Submit saves the limits.

settings-ai-max-tool-rounds.label: Max tool rounds
settings-ai-max-tool-rounds.action: Maximum number of tool-call rounds per agent turn (1–100). Default 50.

settings-ai-max-repeated-tool-calls.label: Max repeated tool calls
settings-ai-max-repeated-tool-calls.action: Stops the agent if the same tool call repeats this many times (1–200). Default 50.

ai-context-form.label: Context compaction form
ai-context-form.action: Contains compaction toggle and token budget settings. Submit saves the context config.

settings-ai-compaction.label: Enable compaction
settings-ai-compaction.action: When enabled, the agent summarizes older conversation history to fit within the token budget.

settings-ai-max-input-tokens.label: Max input tokens
settings-ai-max-input-tokens.action: Token budget for the input prompt before compaction triggers (1000–2000000). Default 12000.

settings-ai-reserve-tokens.label: Reserve tokens
settings-ai-reserve-tokens.action: Tokens reserved for the model response, subtracted from the input budget (0–1000000). Default 3000.

settings-ai-recent-turns.label: Recent turns to keep
settings-ai-recent-turns.action: Number of recent user-assistant turns preserved during compaction (1–100). Default 4.

settings-ai-summary-max-chars.label: Summary max characters
settings-ai-summary-max-chars.action: Maximum character length of the compacted summary (100–1000000). Default 12000.

add-plugin-modal.label: Add Plugin modal
add-plugin-modal.action: Modal overlay containing URL and local install options. Click the backdrop to close.

nusashell-plugin-tab.label: NusaShell Plugin
nusashell-plugin-tab.action: Shows URL, folder, and archive install controls.

native-mcp-name.label: MCP name
native-mcp-name.action: Sets the display name for the native MCP.

native-mcp-args.label: Arguments
native-mcp-args.action: Sets one stdio argument per line.

native-mcp-env.label: Environment JSON
native-mcp-env.action: Sets optional stdio environment variables as JSON.

native-mcp-headers.label: Headers JSON
native-mcp-headers.action: Sets optional HTTP/SSE headers as JSON.

native-mcp-import.label: Import JSON
native-mcp-import.action: Accepts a Cursor-style single-server mcpServers JSON object.

native-mcp-import-btn.label: Fill from JSON
native-mcp-import-btn.action: Parses JSON into the form fields.

native-mcp-save.label: Save MCP
native-mcp-save.action: Writes or updates the native MCP manifest and refreshes inventory.

native-mcp-status.label: MCP status
native-mcp-status.action: Shows native MCP save or validation errors.

install-url-input.label: Install from URL
install-url-input.action: Accepts a URL to a plugin zip/archive. Press Enter or click Install to submit.

install-url-btn.label: Install (URL)
install-url-btn.action: Installs the plugin from the URL in the adjacent input.

install-local-input.label: Selected local plugin
install-local-input.action: Displays the folder or archive returned by the native picker; paths cannot be typed manually.

pick-local-folder-btn.label: Choose folder
pick-local-folder-btn.action: Opens the operating system directory picker and stores the selected plugin folder in the read-only path field.

pick-local-archive-btn.label: Choose archive
pick-local-archive-btn.action: Opens the operating system file picker for zip, tar.gz, or tgz plugin archives.

install-local-btn.label: Install (local)
install-local-btn.action: Installs the folder or archive selected by the native picker.

install-status.label: Install status
install-status.action: Shows installing, success, or error messages. The modal closes automatically after a successful install.

ai-settings-form.label: Provider editor form
ai-settings-form.action: Contains all provider fields. Submit saves the provider configuration.

ai-settings-subtitle.label: Editor subtitle
ai-settings-subtitle.action: Short description of the provider kind.

ai-settings-close.label: Close editor
ai-settings-close.action: Closes the provider editor without saving.

settings-ai-preset-id.label: Preset id (hidden)
settings-ai-preset-id.action: Stores the selected preset id used to pre-fill built-in provider fields.

settings-ai-provider-type.label: Provider type (hidden)
settings-ai-provider-type.action: Stores the internal provider type, e.g. 'openai-compatible'.

provider-custom-fields.label: Custom provider fields
provider-custom-fields.action: Shown only for custom providers. Contains name and id.

settings-ai-name.label: Provider name
settings-ai-name.action: Display name for a custom provider.

settings-ai-id.label: Provider id / prefix
settings-ai-id.action: Machine-friendly id for a custom provider. Read-only when editing.

settings-ai-api.label: API mode
settings-ai-api.action: Always visible. Selects the request dialect supported by the endpoint: Chat Completions or Responses API for OpenAI-compatible providers, and Anthropic Messages where applicable.

settings-ai-base-url.label: Base URL
settings-ai-base-url.action: The provider's OpenAI-compatible or native base URL.

settings-ai-api-key.label: API key
settings-ai-api-key.action: API key for the provider. Leave blank to keep a saved key. Placeholder indicates whether a key exists.

settings-ai-model.label: Default model
settings-ai-model.action: Optional default model id. Can be left blank and chosen per turn.

settings-ai-attempts.label: Attempts
settings-ai-attempts.action: Maximum retry attempts for a single request (1–10).

settings-ai-weight.label: Weight
settings-ai-weight.action: Routing weight used when provider strategy is round-robin.

settings-ai-enabled.label: Enabled
settings-ai-enabled.action: Whether the provider is available for agent turns.

settings-ai-key-state.label: Key state
settings-ai-key-state.action: Indicates whether an API key is saved, optional, or missing.

provider-modal-overlay.label: Provider editor overlay
provider-modal-overlay.action: Clicking outside the provider editor closes it without saving.

provider-delete-overlay.label: Delete overlay
provider-delete-overlay.action: Clicking outside the delete provider dialog closes it.

provider-delete-dialog.label: Delete provider confirmation
provider-delete-dialog.action: Confirms removal of the provider and its saved credentials.

provider-delete-copy.label: Dialog description
provider-delete-copy.action: Explains that the credential, imported models, and settings will be removed.

provider-delete-confirm.label: Delete
provider-delete-confirm.action: Permanently deletes the provider after disabling the button and showing 'Deleting…'.

context-menu.label: Context menu
context-menu.action: Floating menu with actions depending on what was right-clicked.

ctx-cut.label: Cut
ctx-cut.action: Cuts selected text in an input/textarea.

ctx-copy.label: Copy
ctx-copy.action: Copies selected text in an input/textarea.

ctx-paste.label: Paste
ctx-paste.action: Pastes clipboard text into an input/textarea.

ctx-open.label: Open
ctx-open.action: Opens the plugin window for the selected plugin.

ctx-start.label: Start
ctx-start.action: Starts the selected plugin's MCP process.

ctx-stop.label: Force Stop
ctx-stop.action: Stops the selected plugin's MCP process.

ctx-restart.label: Restart
ctx-restart.action: Restarts the selected plugin's MCP process.

ctx-detail.label: Details
ctx-detail.action: Opens the plugin detail drawer for the selected plugin.

ctx-uninstall.label: Uninstall
ctx-uninstall.action: Removes the selected plugin after a confirmation prompt.

nav-jobs.label: Jobs navigation
nav-jobs.action: Switches the main content to the Jobs view.

nav-pipelines.label: Pipelines navigation
nav-pipelines.action: Switches the main content to the Pipelines view.

jobs-empty.label: Jobs empty state
jobs-empty.action: Shown when no jobs are scheduled, with a direction and a New job action.

jobs-empty-new-btn.label: New job (empty state)
jobs-empty-new-btn.action: Opens the New job modal from the empty state.

jobs-error.label: Jobs load error
jobs-error.action: Inline error panel shown when the job list fails to load.

jobs-list.label: Jobs list
jobs-list.action: Renders all scheduled jobs as rows.

job-run-btn.label: Run
job-run-btn.action: Fires the job immediately via job.run. Disabled while the job is running.

job-stop-btn.label: Stop
job-stop-btn.action: Cancels an in-flight job run via job.cancel. Visible only while the job is running.

job-toggle-btn.label: Pause/Resume
job-toggle-btn.action: Toggles job enabled state via job.set-enabled.

job-output-btn.label: Output
job-output-btn.action: Opens the job output modal showing recent run summaries.

job-remove-btn.label: Remove
job-remove-btn.action: Opens the job delete confirmation dialog.

job-edit-btn.label: Edit
job-edit-btn.action: Opens the job modal prefilled with the job's fields for editing via job.update.

job-delete-dialog.label: Delete dialog
job-delete-dialog.action: Confirms job removal before calling job.remove. Closes on Cancel, overlay click, or Escape.

job-delete-copy.label: Delete copy
job-delete-copy.action: States which job will be permanently removed from this device.

job-delete-cancel.label: Cancel
job-delete-cancel.action: Closes the delete dialog without removing the job.

job-delete-confirm.label: Remove
job-delete-confirm.action: Removes the job via job.remove and closes the dialog.

job-field-schedule.label: Schedule
job-field-schedule.action: Schedule expression (every 30m / 2h / 1d / cron / ISO). Validated on blur. Visible only when trigger kind is 'schedule'.

job-field-trigger.label: Trigger kind
job-field-trigger.action: Picker for schedule (time-based) vs event (plugin-triggered). Toggles schedule/event field visibility.

job-schedule-fields.label: Schedule fields
job-schedule-fields.action: Container for schedule input, shown when trigger kind is 'schedule'.

job-event-fields.label: Event fields
job-event-fields.action: Container for event trigger inputs (pattern, plugin, throttle, max fires), shown when trigger kind is 'event'.

job-field-event-pattern.label: Event pattern
job-field-event-pattern.action: Glob pattern matched against automation event types (e.g. mail.new, files.*).

job-event-help.label: Event help
job-event-help.action: Shows available event types from the selected plugin's manifest automation.emits.

job-field-event-plugin.label: Event plugin scope
job-field-event-plugin.action: Optional plugin scope for the event trigger (Any plugin or a specific pluginId).

job-field-throttle-ms.label: Throttle (ms)
job-field-throttle-ms.action: Minimum gap between fires for this event job (coalesce burst events).

job-field-max-fires.label: Max fires/hour
job-field-max-fires.action: Hard cap on dispatches per rolling hour for this event job.

job-schedule-help.label: Schedule help
job-schedule-help.action: Live validation result for the schedule expression.

job-field-mode.label: Mode
job-field-mode.action: Switches between agent prompt and plugin tool call mode.

job-mode-help.label: Mode help
job-mode-help.action: One-line description of the selected mode (agent = uses AI model; tool = no model, direct plugin call).

job-field-prompt.label: Prompt
job-field-prompt.action: Agent prompt for agent-mode jobs. Required when mode is agent.

job-field-provider.label: Provider
job-field-provider.action: AI provider for agent-mode jobs. Default = shell active settings provider.

job-field-model.label: Model
job-field-model.action: AI model for agent-mode jobs. Default = shell active settings model. Options filtered by selected provider.

job-field-effort.label: Effort
job-field-effort.action: Reasoning effort for agent-mode jobs. Only shown when the selected model advertises supported efforts.

job-field-plugin-id.label: Plugin
job-field-plugin-id.action: Plugin dropdown for tool-mode jobs, populated from the live plugin catalog. Starts the plugin if stopped.

job-field-tool-name.label: Tool
job-field-tool-name.action: Tool dropdown for tool-mode jobs, populated after a plugin is selected.

job-tool-schema-form.label: Schema arg form
job-tool-schema-form.action: Dynamic form fields generated from the selected tool's inputSchema. Primitives and enums render as native inputs; object/array properties render as JSON textareas.

job-field-args.label: Args JSON
job-field-args.action: JSON arguments for the tool call.

job-field-repeat.label: Repeat count
job-field-repeat.action: How many times to fire (blank = repeat forever).

job-modal-save.label: Save
job-modal-save.action: Creates the job via job.add and closes the modal.

pipelines-list.label: Pipeline list
pipelines-list.action: Renders pipeline cards with status, trigger, step count, and actions.

pipelines-error.label: Pipelines error
pipelines-error.action: Shown when the pipeline list fails to load.

pipeline-modal-save.label: Save
pipeline-modal-save.action: Creates or updates the pipeline via pipeline.add/update and closes the modal.

pipeline-field-trigger-kind.label: Trigger type
pipeline-field-trigger-kind.action: Toggles between event and schedule trigger fields.

pipeline-add-step-btn.label: Add step
pipeline-add-step-btn.action: Adds a new step row to the pipeline.

pipeline-steps-list.label: Steps list
pipeline-steps-list.action: Renders editable step rows with id, name, action, dependsOn, outputKey.

job-output-expand.label: Show full output
job-output-expand.action: Loads the full markdown body for a run entry via job.output with includeBody.

agent-canvas.label: Canvas overlay drawer
agent-canvas.action: Right-edge overlay drawer for the active canvas artifact. Slides over the agent workbench without resizing the chat column; closed via Close, overlay click, or Escape.

agent-canvas-resize.label: Resize canvas drawer
agent-canvas-resize.action: Drag the left edge to resize the drawer. ArrowLeft/ArrowRight adjust it by keyboard; Home and End go to the widest and narrowest supported sizes.

agent-canvas-overlay.label: Canvas drawer overlay
agent-canvas-overlay.action: Dimmed backdrop behind the canvas drawer; click closes the drawer.

agent-canvas-badge.label: Canvas type badge
agent-canvas-badge.action: Labels the artifact kind (HTML, SVG, or MERMAID).

agent-canvas-body.label: Canvas body
agent-canvas-body.action: Hosts the rendered artifact: a sandboxed iframe for HTML, or a static SVG container for SVG/Mermaid.

agent-canvas-hint.label: Canvas hint
agent-canvas-hint.action: Shows a fallback note when an artifact fails to render.

agent-canvas-refresh.label: Refresh canvas
agent-canvas-refresh.action: Re-runs the render pipeline for the active artifact.

agent-canvas-download.label: Download source
agent-canvas-download.action: Downloads the active artifact source as a file.

agent-canvas-close.label: Close canvas
agent-canvas-close.action: Hides the pane and clears the active artifact for the conversation.

agent-canvas-fence-actions.label: Canvas fence actions
agent-canvas-fence-actions.action: Action row appended to a canvas-tagged code fence.

agent-canvas-fence-btn.label: Canvas fence action button
agent-canvas-fence-btn.action: Sidebar or Show source action attached to a canvas fence. Show source replaces the inline preview with a scrollable ~10-row source block.

agent-canvas-inline.label: Inline canvas render
agent-canvas-inline.action: Static SVG container rendered inline above an svg/mermaid fence on completed assistant messages.

agent-canvas-svg.label: Canvas SVG host
agent-canvas-svg.action: Centered SVG host inside the canvas body for svg/mermaid artifacts.

agent-shell.label: Agent shell grid
agent-shell.action: Two-column agent workbench (conversations · thread). Canvas opens as a fixed overlay drawer and does not add a third grid column.

agent-canvas-card.label: Artifact card
agent-canvas-card.action: Compact card under an auto-rendered HTML preview; shows badge, title, size hint, Sidebar, and Show source.

agent-canvas-card-head.label: Artifact card header
agent-canvas-card-head.action: Header row of an artifact card with badge, title, and meta.

agent-canvas-card-badge.label: Artifact card badge
agent-canvas-card-badge.action: Type badge (HTML) on an artifact card.

agent-canvas-card-title.label: Artifact card title
agent-canvas-card-title.action: Title label on an artifact card (e.g. 'html 1').

agent-canvas-card-meta.label: Artifact card meta
agent-canvas-card-meta.action: Size hint (lines · bytes) on an artifact card.

agent-canvas-card-actions.label: Artifact card actions
agent-canvas-card-actions.action: Action row on an artifact card containing Sidebar and Show source buttons.

agent-canvas-inline-preview.label: Inline HTML preview
agent-canvas-inline-preview.action: In-chat sandboxed iframe auto-rendered for HTML canvas fences on completed assistant messages.

settings-canvas-enabled.label: Agent Canvas
settings-canvas-enabled.action: Enables or disables inline HTML/SVG/Mermaid rendering and the canvas sidebar. When off, canvas fences stay as source code blocks.

agent-subpane.label: Subagent side pane
agent-subpane.action: Full-height drawer that renders the complete live subagent stream with markdown, tool terminals, plans, and permission/ask cards.

agent-subpane-overlay.label: Subagent pane overlay
agent-subpane-overlay.action: Dimmed backdrop behind the Subagent side pane.

agent-subpane-head.label: Subagent pane header
agent-subpane-head.action: Shows the provider badge, run title, live status chip, and close button.

agent-subpane-badge.label: Subagent pane badge
agent-subpane-badge.action: Short uppercase provider id for the active subagent run.

agent-subpane-title.label: Subagent pane title
agent-subpane-title.action: Title of the active subagent run.

agent-subpane-status.label: Subagent pane status
agent-subpane-status.action: Live status chip (RUNNING/OK/FAIL) for the active subagent run.

agent-subpane-close.label: Subagent pane close
agent-subpane-close.action: Closes the Subagent side pane drawer.

agent-subpane-body.label: Subagent pane body
agent-subpane-body.action: Scrollable log that renders the full subagent stream: reasoning disclosures, text bubbles, tool terminals, plan steps, and error blocks.

agent-subagent-card.label: Subagent run card
agent-subagent-card.action: In-chat card representing a subagent run. The head opens the full Subagent side pane; while running, a mini activity stream is shown below the head.

agent-subagent-card-head.label: Subagent card head
agent-subagent-card-head.action: Clickable header that opens the full Subagent side pane for the run.

agent-subagent-card-badge.label: Subagent card badge
agent-subagent-card-badge.action: Short uppercase provider id on the in-chat subagent card.

agent-subagent-card-title.label: Subagent card title
agent-subagent-card-title.action: Title of the subagent run shown on the in-chat card.

agent-subagent-card-status.label: Subagent card status
agent-subagent-card-status.action: Live status chip on the in-chat subagent card (RUNNING/OK/FAIL).

agent-subagent-card-stream.label: Subagent mini activity stream
agent-subagent-card-stream.action: Compact scrollable mini log inside the running subagent card. Mirrors the full side pane as one-line rows (Thinking, text, tool calls, plan). Auto-scrolls while pinned to the bottom; scrolling up pauses stickiness.

agent-subagent-card-stream-row.label: Subagent mini stream row
agent-subagent-card-stream-row.action: Single compact activity row in the mini stream (reasoning, text, tool, or plan).

agent-subagent-card-summary.label: Subagent card summary
agent-subagent-card-summary.action: Markdown summary shown on the sealed subagent card after the run ends.

agent-subagent-card-error.label: Subagent card error
agent-subagent-card-error.action: Error message shown on the subagent card when the run fails.

acp-provider-form-default-model.label: Default model
acp-provider-form-default-model.action: Sets the default model for this ACP agent; mirrored into preferredConfig.model on save.

acp-provider-form-default-mode.label: Default mode (bypass / yolo)
acp-provider-form-default-mode.action: Sets the default mode for this ACP agent; mirrored into preferredConfig.mode on save.

acp-provider-default-model-select.label: Default model
acp-provider-default-model-select.action: Sets the default model for this ACP agent via setDefaultModel; mirrored into preferredConfig.model.

acp-provider-default-mode-select.label: Default mode (bypass / yolo)
acp-provider-default-mode-select.action: Sets the default mode for this ACP agent via setDefaultMode; mirrored into preferredConfig.mode.

acp-provider-import-models.label: Import models
acp-provider-import-models.action: Probes a fresh ACP session, discovers the model list and config-option snapshot, and persists them to the store.

acp-provider-detail-edit.label: Edit
acp-provider-detail-edit.action: Opens the ACP provider configure modal for this agent.

acp-provider-details-back.label: Back to ACP Agents
acp-provider-details-back.action: Returns to the AI Providers view.

acp-provider-detail-title.label: Agent title
acp-provider-detail-title.action: Displays the ACP agent display name.

acp-provider-detail-subtitle.label: Agent description
acp-provider-detail-subtitle.action: Displays the ACP agent manifest description.

acp-provider-detail-command.label: Command
acp-provider-detail-command.action: Displays the resolved command and args for the ACP agent.

acp-provider-detail-auth.label: Auth status
acp-provider-detail-auth.action: Displays the ACP agent auth status (Connected, Needs auth, Not probed).

acp-provider-detail-default-model.label: Default model
acp-provider-detail-default-model.action: Displays the persisted default model id for this ACP agent.

acp-provider-detail-default-mode.label: Default mode
acp-provider-detail-default-mode.action: Displays the effective default mode (preferredConfig.mode or manifest defaultMode).

acp-provider-detail-status.label: Status
acp-provider-detail-status.action: Displays whether the ACP agent is enabled or disabled.

acp-provider-import-error.label: Import error
acp-provider-import-error.action: Shows the error message when an import-models probe fails.

acp-provider-model-count.label: Model count
acp-provider-model-count.action: Displays the number of imported models for this ACP agent.

acp-provider-model-search.label: Search models
acp-provider-model-search.action: Filters the imported model list by id, label, or description.

acp-provider-model-list.label: Model list
acp-provider-model-list.action: Renders the searchable list of imported models.

acp-provider-config-options-card.label: Config options card
acp-provider-config-options-card.action: Wraps the read-only config-option snapshot from the last probe.

acp-provider-config-options.label: Config options
acp-provider-config-options.action: Renders read-only rows for each live config option (excluding model and mode).
